§6Hydrotreater§f

§aStrip the sulfur out of your oils, and get sour gas as a bonus.§f

The §bHydrotreater§f does hydrodesulfurization: it takes petroleum products plus pressurized Liquid Hydrogen (§e1 PU§f) and removes the sulfur, producing §bSour Gas§f as a byproduct. It needs a §bCatalytic Converter§f to run, making it a post-RBMK, post-Vacuum Refinery machine.

It eats §e200 kHE/s§f and processes §e1,000mB§f of input fluid per second (averaging §e50 mB/t§f). The core recipes in JEI: Crude Oil and Cracked Oil both yield §e900mB§f desulfurized product plus §e150mB§f Sour Gas. Diesel gives §e800mB§f High-Octane variant plus §e300mB§f Sour Gas. Natural Gas converts to §e800mB§f Petroleum Gas plus §e150mB§f Sour Gas.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Factory): §e8×§f Welded Steel Plate, §e4×§f Cast Copper Plate, §e8×§f Niobium Ingot, §e4×§f Cadmium Steel Ingot, §e2×§f Steel Shell, §e8×§f Steel Pipe, §e2×§f Desh Motor, §e1×§f Versatile Circuit Board.

§ePS:§f The hydrotreater and §bCatalytic Reformer§f form a loop, reformer produces Liquid Hydrogen, hydrotreater consumes it. The Sour Gas byproduct can be reformed into Sulfuric Acid, so nothing goes to waste.
